title: Long Drives on Safari: How to Make Them Comfortable
excerpt: Some safari days involve long drives on bumpy roads. How to stay comfortable, and when flying is the better option.
body:
## Where

- Arusha to the Serengeti.
- Central to northern Serengeti.
- Between the southern parks.

## Comfort tips

- A neck pillow.
- Snacks and water.
- Breaks every couple of hours.
- Motion sickness tablets if needed.

## Make it a game drive

Most long drives pass through parks, so you watch wildlife on the way.

## Fly instead

See [fly-in safaris](/blog/fly-in-safari/).

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
